defects.summary: At 7ebcc096, a stale valid meme receipt unconditionally moved last-main and meme schedule state backward, while stale current-schema regular receipts cleared and replaced newer quote/image histories before comparing post epochs. Reconciliation could therefore treat an older confirmed transaction as the newest local state.
defects.impact: Replaying an older receipt after newer durable state could erase duplicate-suppression identities, roll the daily-meme guard and next schedule backward, or replace the current main-post identity. This could make an otherwise ineligible repeat post or second same-day meme appear due.

introduced.explanation: The defect was reproduced against the exact 7ebcc096 evidence cut-off. Its first introducing revision was not reconstructed.

chronology.event: Pre-freeze schedule and recovery review reproduced stale regular-history erasure and stale meme-state rollback against the 7ebcc096 cut-off.
chronology.evidence: Synthetic stale-receipt replay with a strictly newer quote/meme state

first_review_scope.scope: Regular schema-v2/v3 and meme schema-v2 confirmed-receipt reconciliation when local histories, main identity, post epochs and schedules already represent a newer transaction.
first_review_scope.exclusions: No live runtime state, remote service or production receipt was used; legacy receipt migration beyond the reproduced states was not reclassified.
first_review_scope.source: Independent pre-freeze scheduler and receipt-replay review

detection.method: Apply one older semantically valid confirmed receipt to state containing a later post epoch, later schedule and additional cycle-history identities, then compare every protected field before and after reconciliation.
detection.reproducer: The stale regular receipt removed newer quote/image identities; the stale meme receipt replaced the later main identity, meme epoch and future schedule and cleared the effective same-day guard.

fix.summary: A post-cut-off proposal makes replay monotonic: only a strictly newer current-schema receipt installs an exact cycle snapshot, stale replays union identities, and stale meme receipts preserve later main, epoch and schedule state. It is not ledger truth until committed and re-attested.

deployment.evidence: No committed descendant repair has been deployed. Production remains observed at be882e81 and was not inspected or changed by this pre-freeze review.

defects.residual_risk: Until a descendant repair is frozen and validated, receipt recovery must not assume that a semantically valid older receipt may overwrite later histories, post identity or schedules.

evidence.claim: The cut-off regular replay clears current histories before freshness comparison and the meme replay assigns last-main, last-meme and next-schedule fields without a monotonicity guard.

unknowns.explanation: The first revision containing both stale replay behaviours was not reconstructed.
No earlier commit was proved safe for both regular and meme stale-receipt replay.
The repair remains an uncommitted post-cut-off candidate.

defects.title: Path-bearing X bases could desynchronise prepared and literal create-route classification

incident.evidence: The defect was reproduced with synthetic path-bearing X base values and a local transport sentinel. No network, X, provider, service or production action occurred.
incident.explanation: This is a cutoff-bound configuration and route-classification reproducer, not evidence that production used a path-bearing endpoint or bypassed an authority check.

defects.summary: At 7ebcc096, X API and upload bases could contain path components which were combined with literal endpoint paths. Create-route authority was decided from the Requests-prepared URL, while other checks and error identity continued to use the caller's literal path. A path-bearing base could therefore make those classifications disagree at the protected tweet or media create boundary.
defects.impact: A configured path prefix, query, fragment or user-information component could make one layer treat a request as a protected create while another did not, weakening the exact receipt-authority and conservative-write checks at a public transport boundary.

introduced.explanation: The mismatch was established against the exact 7ebcc096 evidence cutoff. Its introducing commit and an earlier good implementation were not reconstructed.

chronology.event: Post-cutoff adversarial review combined path-bearing X bases with protected create paths and established disagreement between prepared and literal route identity at 7ebcc096.
chronology.evidence: Synthetic origin/path configuration and pre-transport route-classification fixture

first_review_scope.scope: X API and upload base parsing, prepared Requests URL normalisation, literal path classification, tweet-create and v2 media-create preflight.
first_review_scope.exclusions: The separate xAI provider base intentionally includes /v1 and was not treated as an X public-create origin. No live endpoint was contacted.
first_review_scope.source: Focused endpoint-authority review of the frozen cutoff

detection.method: Supply X API or upload bases with paths and compare the caller's literal protected endpoint with the URL path produced by Requests preparation before allowing any transport.
detection.reproducer: A prefixed X base changes the prepared URL path for POST /2/tweets or POST /2/media/upload while the literal caller path remains a protected create route.
detection.source: Focused origin-only and prepared/literal route regression design

fix.summary: An external post-cutoff candidate requires X API and upload values to be origins only and refuses tweet or media transport when prepared and literal create-route classifications disagree, while preserving the versioned xAI provider base. It remains unresolved in ledger truth until committed and externally attested.

deployment.evidence: No descendant repair is recorded as deployed. Production remained observed at be882e81 and was not inspected or changed by this focused review.

defects.residual_risk: Until a descendant repair is frozen and attested, release validation must reject path-bearing X API/upload bases and cannot rely on prepared and literal create-route identity agreeing by construction.

evidence.claim: The cutoff normaliser accepts and rewrites path-bearing X bases, and prepared request classification is derived from the concatenated base and caller path.
The external post-cutoff candidate regression rejects path, query, fragment and user-information components for X API/upload bases.
The external post-cutoff candidate regression refuses tweet and media transport when prepared and literal create-route classifications disagree.
The external post-cutoff integration fixture rejects formerly tolerated path-bearing X endpoint overrides before transport.

unknowns.explanation: The first revision accepting path-bearing X create bases was not reconstructed.
No earlier origin-only implementation was established.
The current repair and focused tests are uncommitted candidate material and require external frozen-candidate attestation.

defects.title: Accepted legacy confirmed receipts could leave auxiliary provider work unblocked

incident.evidence: The defect was reproduced with synthetic, schema-valid legacy regular, meme and confirmed reply receipts in an isolated state directory. No network, X, provider, service or production action occurred.
incident.explanation: This establishes an omitted global barrier state, not a live duplicate or provider incident.

defects.summary: At 7ebcc096, the global helper classified only sending and invalid regular, meme and conversational receipts as blocking. Schema-valid legacy full or confirmed receipts were accepted as locally reconcilable and therefore did not block unrelated auxiliary provider work or the global scheduler predicate before that local reconciliation completed.
defects.impact: A scheduler or provider lane could begin while one or more confirmed source receipts still required durable local reconciliation. Multiple simultaneous accepted receipts could therefore coexist with auxiliary work even though the transaction policy requires unresolved source state to block unrelated remote activity.

introduced.explanation: The accepted-receipt barrier omission was established against the exact 7ebcc096 evidence cutoff. Its introducing commit was not reconstructed.

chronology.event: Focused cutoff review installed simultaneous valid legacy regular, meme and confirmed conversational receipts and found the global auxiliary barrier open at 7ebcc096.
chronology.evidence: Synthetic simultaneous accepted-receipt preflight fixture with a clean-state negative control

first_review_scope.scope: Global main and conversational receipt predicates for accepted legacy full/confirmed states, simultaneous receipt combinations, auxiliary provider preflight and clean-state false-positive behaviour.
first_review_scope.exclusions: The test did not perform local reconciliation, contact a provider, call X, alter production state or infer a production incident.
first_review_scope.source: Focused accepted-receipt global-barrier review of the frozen cutoff

detection.method: Persist schema-valid legacy full regular and meme receipts plus a confirmed conversational receipt, prove each reader accepts its record, then evaluate the global barrier and auxiliary provider preflight before reconciliation.
detection.reproducer: All three accepted receipts remained present while unresolved_main_post_attempt_is_blocking and unresolved_conversational_reply_receipt_is_blocking returned false.

fix.summary: An external post-cutoff candidate treats every non-absent main or conversational source receipt as a global barrier and permits only a narrow sole-owner main receipt exception to reach local reconciliation. It remains unresolved in ledger truth until committed and externally attested.

deployment.evidence: No descendant repair is recorded as deployed. Production remained observed at be882e81 and was not inspected or changed by this focused review.

defects.residual_risk: Until a descendant repair is frozen and attested, an accepted legacy full or confirmed source receipt cannot be treated as globally resolved merely because it is valid enough for local replay.

evidence.claim: The cutoff global predicates return blocking only for sending or invalid main and conversational receipt statuses, excluding accepted full/confirmed states.
The external post-cutoff candidate regression keeps auxiliary provider preflight closed while accepted regular, meme and conversational source receipts await reconciliation.
The paired negative control proves a fully reconciled empty receipt namespace does not create a false global barrier.

unknowns.explanation: The first revision which excluded accepted legacy full/confirmed states from the global barrier was not reconstructed.
No earlier revision was established as blocking every unresolved accepted source receipt globally.
The current repair and focused tests are uncommitted candidate material and require external frozen-candidate attestation.

defects.title: Configured X upload origin was ignored by v2 media requests

incident.evidence: The mismatch was reproduced with distinct synthetic loopback API and upload origins. No network, X, provider, service or production action occurred.
incident.explanation: This is a cutoff-bound configuration-routing defect, not evidence that production configured or required a distinct upload origin.

defects.summary: At 7ebcc096, X_UPLOAD_BASE_URL was parsed, normalised and reported by configuration checks, but x_request constructed every X URL from X_BASE. An explicitly configured upload origin therefore had no effect on POST /2/media/upload.
defects.impact: A deployment which intentionally separates its v2 media-upload origin from its ordinary X API origin would silently send the upload request to the ordinary API origin. The reproduced impact is incorrect configuration behaviour and possible upload failure, not a demonstrated duplicate or live incident.

introduced.explanation: The ignored upload-origin behaviour was established against the exact 7ebcc096 evidence cut-off. Its introducing revision was not reconstructed.

chronology.event: A four-way post-cutoff adversarial review used distinct local API and upload origins and established that media upload still selected X_BASE at the evidence cut-off.
chronology.evidence: Distinct loopback-origin routing fixture with separate media, tweet and read observations

first_review_scope.scope: X API/upload environment parsing, effective defaults, media-upload URL construction, ordinary X reads and tweet creates.
first_review_scope.exclusions: No live endpoint was contacted and no claim is made that production supplied a distinct upload origin.
first_review_scope.source: Four-way pre-freeze API and media-routing review

detection.method: Assign different local loopback origins to the X API and upload settings, then observe which origin receives media, tweet and read requests.
detection.reproducer: POST /2/media/upload reached the API-origin sentinel rather than the configured upload-origin sentinel.

fix.summary: An external post-cutoff candidate routes only exact POST /2/media/upload requests to the configured upload origin, makes an unset upload origin inherit the effective API origin and keeps reads and tweet creates on the API origin. It remains unfixed in ledger truth until a descendant is frozen, attested and the ledger is regenerated.

deployment.evidence: No descendant routing repair is recorded as deployed. Production was not changed or contacted by this review.

defects.residual_risk: Until a descendant repair is frozen and attested, release validation cannot claim that a configured upload origin controls v2 media transport.

evidence.claim: The cutoff parses X_UPLOAD_BASE_URL but constructs X request URLs from X_BASE.
The external descendant candidate regression proves media and tweet creates select their respective configured origins.
The external descendant unit regression limits upload-origin selection to the exact protected media-create route.

unknowns.explanation: The first revision which parsed but did not route through X_UPLOAD_BASE_URL was not reconstructed.
No earlier revision was proved to route distinct API and upload origins correctly.
The repair remains uncommitted descendant candidate material and requires external frozen-candidate attestation.

defects.title: Final pretransport pause could strand a definitely untransmitted media barrier pair

incident.evidence: The availability boundary was reproduced using a synthetic pause transition after durable receipt/fence publication and before a local transport sentinel. No HTTP, network, X, provider, service or production action occurred.
incident.explanation: The durable pair remained fail closed and therefore did not create a duplicate-write opening; the established defect is unnecessary manual recovery of a definitely untransmitted transaction.

defects.summary: At 7ebcc096, if the supported pause became active at the final pretransport check after a v2 media receipt/fence pair had been durably published, the request was correctly not transmitted but the pair remained as an unresolved global barrier. No exact process-only authority existed to retire that definitely untransmitted pair.
defects.impact: The bot could remain conservatively blocked and require operator reconciliation even though the media request was proved not to have reached the transport boundary. This is an availability and recovery defect; the surviving receipt/fence preserved duplicate safety.

introduced.explanation: The pause boundary was established against the exact 7ebcc096 evidence cut-off. Its first introducing revision was not reconstructed.

chronology.event: A four-way transaction review paused the media lane after durable pair publication but before transport and established that the definitely untransmitted pair remained as a manual blocker.
chronology.evidence: Final-pretransport pause fixture with a transport sentinel and exact receipt/fence inspection

first_review_scope.scope: Media receipt/fence publication, final pause preflight, one-shot transport-authority consumption and fail-closed recovery before and after consumption.
first_review_scope.exclusions: No remote transport occurred. Post-consumption uncertainty remains an ambiguity case and was not reclassified as definitely untransmitted.
first_review_scope.source: Four-way pre-freeze transaction and filesystem-boundary review

detection.method: Publish and revalidate an exact media receipt/fence pair, activate the supported pause before the final transport-authority consumption, and verify transport is not reached while the pair remains present.
detection.reproducer: RemoteOperationsPaused was raised before transport, but the exact sending pair remained and blocked later remote operations until manual recovery.

fix.summary: An external post-cutoff candidate issues a process-local, exact-object, single-use cleanup authority only after durable pair publication and reread. A final pause before transport consumption can remove that definitely untransmitted pair with identity, content, lifecycle and durability checks; reconstructed, consumed, unsafe or interrupted cases remain fail closed. It remains unfixed in cutoff truth until frozen, attested and regenerated into a later ledger.

deployment.evidence: No descendant cleanup-authority repair is recorded as deployed. Production was not changed or contacted by this review.

defects.residual_risk: Until a descendant repair is frozen and attested, a final pretransport pause after media pair publication may require manual operator recovery; the existing pair must remain treated as a duplicate-safe global barrier.

evidence.claim: The cutoff performs a final pause check after media pair publication without an exact definitely-untransmitted retirement path.
The external descendant regression proves a pre-consumption pause retires only the exact definitely untransmitted pair without creating an ambiguity marker.
The external descendant literal-process regression proves every interrupted cleanup state is either empty because no transport occurred or remains restart-blocking.
The paired regression proves a pause after transport-authority consumption is not misclassified as definitely untransmitted and remains fail closed.

unknowns.explanation: The first revision with this final-pretransport pause and media-pair recovery interaction was not reconstructed.
No earlier revision was proved to cleanly retire only definitely untransmitted media pairs at this pause boundary.
The repair remains uncommitted descendant candidate material and requires external frozen-candidate attestation.
